heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, followed by periods of clouds developing overnight. Lows in the 50s to near 60, some mid 60s along Lake Champlain. Light and variable wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Sun mixing with clouds. A slight chance of a late-day shower or rumble of thunder in the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs in the 80s. Light and variable wind becoming south at 5 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Periods of clouds. Lows in the 50s to low 60s, a few mid 60s along Lake Champlain. Calm wind.
